sentences.text: Faijuddin vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 February, 2020

Author: Prakash Shrivastava
Bench: Prakash Shrivastava
 High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 1 Cr
 Cr.R. No.740/2020
 Faijuddin Vs. State of Mp
 Indore, Dated : 12.02.2020
 Shri Nitin Vyas, learned counsel for the applicant
 Shri A.Tugnawat, learned counsel for the responden
Let the original record be requisitioned.
Heard on I.A.No.1253/2020 which is an application for suspension of sentence of applicant u/S.397 of the Cr.P.C pending the revision.

The applicant has been convicted for offence u/S.16(1)a(I) read with Sec.16(II) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo six months RI with fine of Rs.15,000/- with default stipulation.

Having regard to the fact that short sentence of six months has been awarded and also considering the age of the applicant and the medical documents which are pointed out by counsel for applicant and the period for which the applicant has already remained in custody and the fact that revision petition is not likely to be heard on the question of admission early, I am of the opinion that a case for suspension of sentence is made out.

Hence, IA No.1253/2020 is allowed and it is directed that on furnishing bail bond to the tune of Rs.20,000/- (Rs. Twenty Thousand) with one separate surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 30/3/2020 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry, the applicant be released on bail and the substantive sentence shall remain suspended pending this revision.
List on 2/3/2020.
C.C.as per rules.
